title: The Madras High Court yesterday restrained ITC Ltd from sale of their Sunfeast Mom’s Magic Butter biscuits in blue wrapper which is identical to Britania’s Good Day. The order was on a plea filed by Britania saying that it is a violation of Trade Marks Act, 1999.
